Handoff 2026-11-18 ~18:30 KST from the office track/agent-v2 lead (session key possum-clay-halved, epic 261114-epic-ws-common-session-foundation). The owner continues at home: daemon swap plus live agy-lead check. Office PC rules are unchanged: Go tests on w5090 only, no local go test, no ws test exes.

LANDED on track/agent-v2 (pushed with this note; develop merge still waits for the owner's explicit approval):
- 733201615 develop sync merge; c01390dff hosted prompt assembly Phase 1.
- agy Phase 1 of 261118-feat-ws-agy-tool-names-and-worker-role: e69a4a620 impl, cbe4f73f7 Result, d902c66b8 fix, 56de4fb29 Edition.
  - A harness descriptor on BackendRegistration (ToolNameScheme, ManualHarness). Claude declares claude; agy declares agy plus sanitize.
  - agy hosted connections advertise underscore aliases. The sanitize scheme turns '.' into '_' with no ws__ prefix, because agy adds mcp_ws_ itself ((146)); so tickets.query is advertised as tickets_query.
  - callTool reverse-maps the alias before hostedSessionKeyRule. That rule fills a missing session_key from the canonical tool schema, so it must see canonical names.
  - The playbook render harness comes from ManualHarness. The connection harness and server_harness.go are unchanged.
  - w5090 build, vet and test passed (cmd/ws-mcp, internal/mcp, internal/wsagent). Compatibility tier T0.
- New todo tickets: 261118-refactor-ws-harness-name-branches (about 50 harness-name branches in common code); 261118-feat-ws-display-transcript-memory-first (perf golden-rule violations in the display transcript).

AT HOME (owner):
1. Pre-swap: no Pi worker running anywhere; hosted holders restart_safe; coordinate with any other session on the same daemon.
2. Pull track/agent-v2, build from source, swap the daemon with --replace.
3. Live check per (132): open a hosted agy lead on Gemini and call one ws tool (for example tickets_query). Then switch to a Claude model and call a ws tool; it passes when the per-turn tool-name error is gone. The workflow_manual render also works. It has no agy-specific wording yet: the agy overlay is missing, which is 261117-feat-ws-hosted-prompt-assembly's job.

OFFICE PC agy FINDING (premise of (133) changed): agy 1.5.11 is installed at %LOCALAPPDATA%\agy\bin\agy.exe, and that directory is on the User PATH. Processes started before the install (terminals, Claude sessions, the running ws daemon) miss it. The daemon resolves agy by exec.LookPath on its own process PATH (wsagent/agy.go:89,140; backend.go:489-499), so swap from a freshly opened terminal. The owner chose to swap at home ((148)=b).

OPEN: Phase 2 (agy worker role) waits for custom-agent probes 1-3 of 261118-research-ws-agy-custom-agent-prompt on the Mac ((140)). Board topics agy-switch and agy-custom-agent live on this session's whiteboard.
